reason: The primitive monoclinic cell and Z = 1 are strongly supported by indexing, and both submitted Pm models are chemically plausible M3S4-like frameworks. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established: the comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable; the reported 6.47% and 9.95% values are ad hoc unweighted RMS ratios rather than comparable Rwp values; and the best profile RMS (0.345) remains about 3.5 times the estimated low-intensity noise (about 0.10). The trajectory gave full final Pm whole-profile refinement only to the Ti/Cr swap pair after fixing the Ag placement and topology, while other cation-site assignments and lower-symmetry realizations were screened mainly as unrefined, local, or chemically penalized trials. Thus the cell, Z, and average framework have substantial support, but the submitted symmetry, precise sulfur coordinates, and complete element ordering retain material ambiguity. Another attempt with comparable whole-pattern refinement and explicitly instantiated competing orderings/symmetries is warranted.
